text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Which should I borrow? I think I've<n>read this one
before... Oh!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I've never seen this book before... I<n>thought I'd
read everything from<n>Carrot Publications.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Wait, could this be... the new<n>release?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Wow... I can't believe it's already<n>here.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-I shouldn't... but maybe reading just<n>a little won't
hurt.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Just like that, Rice Shower loses<n>herself in the book,
forgetting the time<n>and missing training completely.
